documentation: Baseline for test/suite/no-sync-in-session-path.test.ts. `blocking` lists the blocking primitives that are already reachable from the RPC session path and are NOT owned by the async-credential/footer work; a blocking call site that is not listed here fails the audit. `syncFs` lists every synchronous filesystem call reachable from that path with the bytes it moves; a NEW entry or a higher count fails the audit, a removed one never does. Entries are keyed by (file, api, enclosing symbol) - line numbers are informational and are not compared.

blocking.note: sync credential-lock backoff, bounded by FILE_STORAGE_SYNC_LOCK_BUDGET_MS (1s). Pre-existing and NOT owned by the async-credential work: the sync `withLock` API is what the TUI and every sync credential writer use. Tracked for a follow-up that gives those callers an async lock.
sync settings-lock backoff, same 1s budget and same shape as the credential lock above. Pre-existing; a settings write from a session can hold the loop for up to 1s under contention.
`which`/`where` probe with a 5s timeout, memoized per executable by the shell-config cache, so a session pays it at most once per host lifetime per binary. Pre-existing.
win32-only `taskkill /T` on a tracked child, 5s timeout. Reachable only from the Windows kill path of a tool's child process. Pre-existing.
archive extraction for an on-demand tool download, 60s timeout, off the hot path (first use of a missing bundled tool). Pre-existing.
